name: Campfire Grill at Conestoga Ranch Seared Salmon, Ribeye Steak or Farmhouse Omelet
brandOrRestaurant: Campfire Grill at Conestoga Ranch (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Bear Lake's best scratch sit-down kitchen: pan-seared sustainable salmon, steaks, and morning egg omelets cooked to order with whole ingredients.
prepOrOrderInstructions: For dinner, order the Pan-Seared Salmon or Steak with plain potatoes; for breakfast, order the Farmhouse Omelet or Wrangler Egg Sandwich with eggs, meat, and aged cheese only.
watchOuts: Request sauces and compound butters on the side
